visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt over a light base layer, stands in an outdoor pedestrian walkway flanked by lush green trees and residential high-rise buildings. He holds a sleek black Sony smartphone, gesturing with both hands toward the camera while maintaining a smiling facial expression. (2) High-definition product beauty shots transition in, showcasing the smartphone's rear triple-camera module featuring ZEISS T* branding. The phone's metallic edges catch the natural daylight, and the front screen displays a colorful abstract graphic. Background elements are blurred out to emphasize the device's physical texture and design details. (3) The man demonstrates the camera software interface. Digital overlays including a tracking rectangle appear on the screen, following his body movements as he walks along the tiled pavement. The background consists of manicured park greenery and stone pathways under bright, even natural lighting conditions. (4) A split-screen demonstration illustrates vertical and horizontal framing modes. The man is seen walking away from the camera in a scenic outdoor environment with diverse foliage. Large white text captions appear on the lower half of the frame, indicating different recording perspectives. (5) The camera captures extreme macro shots of a flower, revealing microscopic textures and vivid blue and purple hues. Following this, the man returns to the center of the frame, holding the phone and speaking directly to the viewer while standing in the same sunlit garden walkway.
